Minerva: A Programmable memory test benchmark for language models

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A programmable memory-test benchmark, where memory means the context. It covers atomic tasks (search, recall/edit, match/compare, spot-the-difference, set operations, stateful processing of quantity and set state) plus composite tasks. Contexts are mostly 4K tokens, extended to 16K/32K in the append
